review_description: Everything went according to plan. I'm only waiting on a Sungrow smart meter.

Our experience with R Jay Solar has been one that we could not rate highly enough.  The whole process beginning with the customer support offered through to the installation process was very professional.  The pricing was competitive from the start.  We were very impressed with the care taken by the installers and our job was completed efficiently and in a very friendly manner.  We are very happy to recommend R J Solar to our family and friends.

AS this was all new for us it is difficult to compare. Our 'nice' salesperson convinced us to go with 12 Neon panels and Enphase inverters because of issues with trees and shade. We have the system running after a nearly 7 week wait for Origin our retailer to send someone out to install the necessary bits they do. Turned it on four days ago. All looks good. We imported up to 25 KW a day when the conservative estimate from installer was 18 to 20 kw. This in early October in Brisbane.

I researched RJAY, and found generally good reviews even via your site. It was valuable getting quotes and knowledge via the process and your site was very useful.I know RJAY dont subscribe to your site. I understand their reasons, however, it means i think none of your suppliers could quote on LG. (I might be wrong about that).REGARDS

We were more than happy with John, Aaron, Jason and the team who installed our solar panel array.R Jay Electrical removed my old 1.2kWh system, installed new feet and rail system to tile roof and worked around our roof restoration project. R Jay Electrical arranged all the paperwork for energy network, rebates for STC's through to post installation monitoring system. Exceptional service.Our Micro Inverter system is Enphase IQ7+ with system monitoring with 34 x LG Neon 2 panels. I would highly recommend R Jay Electrical with prompt communication, quality service and a great installation team. I have slashed my power bills to zero since! Talk to the team and spend your money on a quality system with the service to back you up!P.S 1000kWh (Kilo Watt Hours) or 1MWH (Mega Watt Hours) produced in 20 days with some overcast and rainy days is impressive!

Our system is vented throughout the house and we have 4 zones. Energex contacted me on June 8th and allocated a CX number.  We were told in June that Energex are the only ones that can hook up the system and turn it on. Our system was installed in the last week of June, it is now July 17 and I have phoned our supplier and installer as we haven't heard from Energex for their finalisation and hook up. Now I am told that no, Energex only send us the next CX number and that our power supplier needs to set it and turn it on. This change apparently happened in December 2017. I wonder how long it would have taken our supplier to realise they had given us the wrong information and we were still sitting here waiting for the email from Energex?Anyway, they have been helpful now in getting us underway. The guys that did the installation were all very nice and the company sent another person out to change one of our zones and the water around the motor.

A very professional quote and guys turned up on time and the install was very professionally done.Did a good job with clean up and rubbish removal.We received a follow up phone call to make sure everything was to our satisfaction.Would highly recommend this company.

Their knowledge of the product was the best, there was no pressure tactics and thanks to Solar Quotes I was able to gain enough knowledge on solar to ask the right questions. From the knowledge I gained and RJay Electricals experience we got a great system. We paid more than we first expected to, but we feel we got great solar panels and inverter. The installation was first rate and I cannot fault them, even down to painting external conduit, very important as we are in a townhouse complex. Would I recommend them, most definitely. RJay Electrical is also a recommended LG panel installer.

Adam from RJ Electrical was very open and straight forward with us when he came to give us a quote. He spent a great deal of time explaining everything and anything we needed or wanted to know and did so in comprehensive yet understandable detail.We really liked the fact that he knew what he was talking about and was not just a sales person (he has previous experience in solar installation and also works on the RJ Electrical installations). We felt that we could trust his advice and there was absolutely no pressure to choose his company. We also liked that RJ Electrical do not just work with solar and have been around for a while. Another positive was that the LG solar panels come with a warranty that is transferable (if the house is sold) which is great and rare from what I can tell. The whole experience with RJ Electrical was stress free and we would whole heartedly recommend them to anyone wanting a top quality system that doesn't cost the earth that comes with honest and practical advice from the first encounter to the last.
